title: 用频率支持观点
prompt_en: How often do you do these activities?
prompt_zh: 你做这些活动的频率如何？
description: 频率副词含义和高低排序
knowledge_points: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
teaching_markdown:
## 频率副词

always 100% → usually 80-90% → often 60-70% → sometimes 30-50% → rarely 5-10% → never 0%

title: 频率副词的位置与频率问句
prompt_en: Where do frequency adverbs go in a sentence?
prompt_zh: 频率副词放在句子的什么位置？
description: 频率副词在一般动词前、be动词后；频率问句
knowledge_points: How often, once/twice a..., is always, is sometimes
teaching_markdown:
## 频率位置

一般动词前：I usually practice.
be动词后：Emma is always ready.
问句：How often do you...?

title: 现在进行时肯定句
prompt_en: What are you doing right now?
description: am/is/are + 动词-ing 系统掌握
knowledge_points: I am...ing, He/She is...ing, We/They are...ing, It is...ing
teaching_markdown:
## 进行时肯定

I am reading.
He is talking.
They are waiting.
It is raining.

title: 现在进行时否定句与疑问句
prompt_en: What is NOT happening? Are you studying?
prompt_zh: 什么没在发生？你在学习吗？
description: 否定和疑问的现在进行时
knowledge_points: I'm not...ing, isn't...ing, Are you...ing?, What is...doing?
teaching_markdown:
## 进行时否定与疑问

I'm not working.
She isn't cooking.
Are you studying?
What is Ben doing?

title: 区分习惯、此刻和临时变化
prompt_en: Is this a habit or happening right now?
prompt_zh: 这是习惯还是正在发生？
description: 一般现在时 vs 现在进行时的对比
knowledge_points: 一般现在 vs 进行时, right now, today, this week, for now
teaching_markdown:
## 习惯vs此刻

习惯：I take the bus every day.
此刻：I am walking right now.
临时：I am working at home this week.

title: 状态动词与动作动词
prompt_en: Is this a state or an action?
description: 区分think/know/look/feel的状态与动作意义
knowledge_points: think vs thinking about, feel vs feeling, look vs looking at, know (no -ing)
teaching_markdown:
## 状态vs动作

I think it is useful. (状态)
I'm thinking about it. (动作)
I know the answer. (状态，不用进行时)

title: 用have区分状态与活动
prompt_en: Do you have something, or are you having an activity?
prompt_zh: 你拥有某物，还是正在进行活动？
description: have表示拥有和have表示活动的区分
knowledge_points: I have (拥有), I'm having (活动), has, We're having
teaching_markdown:
## have双重用法

I have a desk. (拥有)
I'm having lunch. (进行活动)
❌ I'm having a car.

title: 用get描述到达、收到和变得
description: get + 地点/名词/形容词的三种含义
knowledge_points: get + 地点(到达), get + 名词(收到), get + 形容词(变得), be getting + 形容词
teaching_markdown:
## get三种含义

get home (到达)
get feedback (收到)
get easier (变得)
It's getting late. (正在变)
